Product Features

  • The size is ideal for small living rooms: with its square dimensions of 70 x 70 x 35 cm, this coffee table fits perfectly in front of a small sofa without taking up much space. Thanks to the height of 35 cm, it is also easily accessible for coffee mugs. A space-saving coffee table for small apartments.
  • The combination of materials exudes quality: the tempered glass tabletop is transparent and high-quality, the drawer fronts are made of high-gloss material, and the white MDF body adds a touch of understated luxury.
  • The drawers are full of thoughtful details: the two drawers are just the right size to store small items such as remote controls and data cables, so you don't have to search the whole table, which immediately improves the order on your desk.
  • Stable and loadable up to 60 kg: The material made of tempered glass and MDF easily supports 60 kg, making it ideal for placing laptops, fruit plates and decorative items. It meets all your daily needs.
  • Atmosphere with LED light strips at the touch of a button: The light strips can be conveniently controlled via app. Switch to warm light for TV shows or vibrant colors for cozy gatherings. The soft light on the white cabinets transforms the living room into a relaxing oasis of well-being in no time at all.
  • The open middle compartment is super practical: you can easily put your favorite magazines and snacks in the open area in the middle without having to bend down to open the drawer. In this way, it becomes a kind of "storage place" for leisure time.
  • High-gloss fronts are easy to clean: the drawer fronts are made of a high-gloss material, so dust and stains can be removed with a single wipe, making cleaning stress-free for lazy people. Front + Back
  • The design is versatile and adaptable to different styles: the combination of glass, high gloss and light strip makes it a visually appealing addition to any living room, whether modern or minimalist.
  • MDF is a durable and robust material: MDF cabinets are stable and wear-resistant. They are insensitive to wear and tear when opening and closing drawers or when loading and unloading objects. Even after many years of use, they remain clean and like new.

Descriptions

Describe

Total dimensions: 70 x 70 x 35 cm. This coffee table has a drawer with a high-gloss front (drawer front) and a tempered glass tabletop that can support up to 60 kg. It is equipped with an app-controllable LED light strip, impresses with its stylish design, a recess in the middle and is made of white MDF.

App application and manager:

1. iOS and Android systems can download the "LotusLantern" app by scanning the QR code. To do this, open a browser or other tool with the "Scan QR Code" feature and scan the "LotusLantern" QR code (the QR code is in the user manual). 2. Click on the LotusLantern app icon to open the app page. 3. If Bluetooth is not enabled in the app interface, you will see the message "An application wants to enable the Bluetooth function of this device". Click 'Allow.' 4. Simply stick the light strip to a clean, dry surface with the self-adhesive backing. Use the included tape to improve adhesion. Please test the LED light strips before installation and install them carefully. If you have any questions, please contact us.
